patches.apps/desktop/scripts/electron-launcher.m: Forwards T3CODE_DESKTOP_USER_DATA_DIR so the Electron comparison harness runs on an isolated profile.
patches.apps/desktop/src/app/DesktopApp.ts: Publishes the ready local backend to a rendezvous file so Lynxtron can attach to the same environment.
Honors the explicit userData override before probing legacy profile paths.
Adds the userData override and the temp directory the rendezvous file is written to.
patches.apps/desktop/src/main.ts: Passes the temp directory into DesktopEnvironment for the rendezvous file.
patches.apps/desktop/src/preview/Manager.ts: Product fix, not Lynx-specific: preview popups load only normalized URLs with supported protocols. Upstream candidate.
patches.apps/server/src/cli/config.ts: Adds the T3CODE_STATIC_DIR override the Electron comparison scripts use to serve a fresh Web build.
patches.apps/server/src/orchestration/Layers/Pro: Product fix: rejects turn start with a clear error when the provider instance is unavailable, disabled or unauthenticated. Upstream candidate.
Product fixes: buffers reasoning deltas into a Thinking activity, settles the session on turn.aborted, refreshes the provider after an authentication error. Upstream candidate.
patches.apps/server/src/orchestration/decider.ts: Product fix: thread.turn.interrupt without a turn id targets the active turn; the Lynxtron connector relies on it. Upstream candidate.
patches.apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudeAd: Product fix: treats error results as failed turns and classifies expired logins as authentication_error. Upstream candidate.
patches.apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudePr: Product fix: trusts `claude auth status` over stale account metadata. Upstream candidate.
patches.apps/server/src/provider/Layers/Provider: Product fix: marks the thread session stopped when its provider runtime has stopped, so Working reflects reality. Upstream candidate.
patches.apps/server/src/review/ReviewService.ts: Product fix: allows review diffs for any registered project root. Upstream candidate.
patches.apps/server/src/sourceControl/SourceCont: Adds a typed discovery error and test-only env hooks that force loading and error states for Lynxtron captures.
patches.apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriverCore.tes: Adds a test for status on a repository with an unborn HEAD; no source change.
patches.apps/server/src/ws.ts: Adds a test-only write delay hook so Lynxtron captures can observe the file-saving state.
patches.apps/web/package.json: Lists @lynx-js/react and @t3tools/lynx-logic so the .lynx modules under apps/web resolve them.
patches.package.json: Adds the dev:lynxtron, build:lynxtron and start:lynxtron scripts.
patches.packages/client-runtime/package.json: Exports ./connection/presentation and ./state/git-actions as single modules for the Lynx client.
patches.packages/client-runtime/src/connection/p: Adds the connection banner projection the Lynxtron connector banner renders.
patches.packages/client-runtime/src/environment/: Uses type casts instead of Schema constructors so the Lynx bundle does not pull Effect Schema through this module.
patches.packages/client-runtime/src/errors/trans: Adds presentThreadCommandErrorMessage, used by the Lynx client for failed thread commands.
patches.packages/client-runtime/src/state/gitAct: Adds Initialize Git, Publish repository and provider-specific change-request wording to the quick-action resolver the Lynx header uses.
patches.packages/client-runtime/src/state/projec: Product fix: optimistic file atoms keep a five-minute idle TTL so unsaved edits survive reopening a file panel.
patches.packages/contracts/src/ipc.ts: Adds the Latest desktop stage label used by Lynxtron branding.
patches.packages/contracts/src/keybindings.ts: Moves the jump-command arrays to a Schema-free module and adds the settings.open command.
patches.packages/contracts/src/providerRuntime.t: Adds the authentication_error runtime error class the server fixes use.
patches.packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts: Lets source control discovery fail with SourceControlDiscoveryError.
patches.packages/shared/src/keybindings.ts: Adds the default mod+, binding for settings.open.
patches.packages/shared/src/model.ts: Moves provider-option helpers to providerOptions.ts so the Lynx bundle can import them without the rest of model.ts.
patches.packages/shared/src/preview.ts: Adds describePreviewError and resolvePreviewActionUrl, used by the Lynx browser panel.
patches.pnpm-workspace.yaml: Allows Lynxtron build scripts, exempts the pinned Lynxtron packages from the release-age rule, and registers the app-builder-lib patch.
patches.vite.config.ts: Keeps generated fidelity reports out of formatting.

additions..impeccable.md: Design context for the design skills used on the Lynx client.
additions.apps/desktop/src/backend/DesktopLocalEnv: Writes and removes the rendezvous file DesktopApp.ts publishes.
additions.packages/contracts/src/keybindingConstan: Schema-free jump-command arrays imported by keybindings.ts and the Lynx keybindings module.
additions.packages/shared/src/localEnvironmentRend: Rendezvous descriptor shared by apps/desktop and the Lynxtron main process.
additions.packages/shared/src/providerOptions.ts: Provider-option helpers moved out of model.ts.
